Pyodide: where its source code is
=================================

This file carries Pyodide 314.0.7 in executable form (pyodide.js,
pyodide.asm.mjs, pyodide.asm.wasm, python_stdlib.zip), distributed under the
Mozilla Public License 2.0 (its full text is listed beside this one). As MPL
section 3.2(a) asks, the source code of these files is available at:

  https://github.com/pyodide/pyodide/releases/tag/314.0.7
  https://github.com/pyodide/pyodide (the commit of tag 314.0.7)

pyodide.asm.wasm also links hiwire, Pyodide's JavaScript reference table,
under the same licence; its source is at:

  https://github.com/pyodide/hiwire (commit 6a1e67280a15d929ebeceee54a6358c9c8d5f697,
  the one Pyodide 314.0.7's cpython/Makefile builds)

What this copy changed
----------------------

pyodide.js, pyodide.asm.mjs and pyodide.asm.wasm are the release's files,
unmodified.

python_stdlib.zip is NOT the release's file. AgDB's pinned builder
(pymol-wasm/ in the AgDB repository, build.sh step 5b) made it from the
release's python_stdlib.zip (in pyodide-core-314.0.7.tar.bz2 at the release
link above) as follows, and changed nothing else:

  - The 167 modules the PyMOL viewer imports while it starts
    (pymol-wasm/pyc_targets.json, "stdlib") are shipped compiled: each x.py is
    replaced, at the same place in the archive, by x.pyc, the bytecode the
    same Pyodide 314.0.7 CPython (3.14.2) compiles from that x.py
    (unchecked-hash, optimize 0, without the column table), and the x.py
    itself is left out. The text of no file was edited.
  - 15 of those modules are Pyodide's own Python code, covered by the MPL:
    _pyodide/__init__.py, _pyodide/_base.py, _pyodide/_core_docs.py,
    _pyodide/_future_helper.py, _pyodide/_importhook.py,
    _pyodide/docs_argspec.py, _pyodide/docstring.py, _pyodide/jsbind.py,
    pyodide/__init__.py, pyodide/_package_loader.py, pyodide/_state.py,
    pyodide/code.py, pyodide/common.py, pyodide/ffi/__init__.py,
    pyodide/webloop.py. They are in Executable Form only in this copy; their
    Source Code Form is the same path in the release's python_stdlib.zip, and
    in the pyodide repository at the tag above (src/py/).
  - The other 152 are CPython standard-library modules (Python Software
    Foundation License, LICENSE.cpython.txt). This paragraph is the brief
    summary of the changes made to Python that the PSF License (clause 3) asks
    a derivative work to include: those 152 modules are shipped as bytecode
    without their source, and the archive is re-compressed. Their source is
    the release's python_stdlib.zip, or CPython 3.14.2.
  - Every member of the archive is re-compressed with deflate level 9 (the
    release uses level 6); the uncompressed content of every member not named
    above is byte-identical to the release's.
